p1.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|A civil war burns between the stars.

p2.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|For a generation, the Empire has answered every question with a fleet, and every objection with silence.

p3.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|Now a handful of rebels have stolen something it cannot afford to lose. The design of a station large enough to end a world.

p4.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|One ship carries that secret, and it is running out of dark to hide in.

t1.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|Above the desert world of Tatooine, a stolen secret races through the dark.

t2.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|Below, twin suns burn over an ocean of sand. A world so poor, so far from anything that matters, that nobody thinks to look here.

t3.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|That is precisely why they came.

t4.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|For eleven more seconds, the sky is empty.

c1.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|She is a diplomatic corvette. Unarmoured, barely armed, built to carry envoys, not fugitives.

c2.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|Inside her is a princess of the Alliance, and the plans she was sent to deliver.

c4.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|The thing behind her is a mile and a half of grey armour, and it is in no hurry at all.

c5.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|It does not need to be quick. It only needs to be inevitable.

c6.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|Her deflectors hold for ninety seconds.

c7.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|Then the turbolasers find her drives, and the small ship goes dark.

c8.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|There is no distress call. There is nobody close enough to answer one.

k1.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|Powerless, she is drawn in. Held in a beam she cannot break, against a hull that could swallow her whole.

k2.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|Magnetic clamps take hold. Somewhere forward, a cutting charge begins to burn through a sealed door.

k3.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|The crew have perhaps two minutes. They know exactly what they intend to spend them on.

d1.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|Ship security. Six of them. Flak vests, and carbines meant for pirates.

d3.signature: en_GB-alan-medium|0.98|comm|Hold this passage. Whatever comes through that door, hold it.

d4.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|The door does not open. It comes apart.

d5.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|White armour, moving in pairs, advancing behind its own fire. This is not a boarding action. It is a procedure.

d6.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|It is finished in under a minute.

d7.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|And then the shooting stops, which is worse.

d8.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|He does not hurry either. He has never had to.

l1.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|While they tear apart the forward decks, she is already moving aft.

l2.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|In her hand is the complete readout of the station. Every corridor, every conduit, and one flaw its builders never found.

l3.signature: en_US-amy-medium|1.02|interior|Every deck. Every shaft. Get this to the surface.

l4.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|She has seconds, and exactly one courier the Empire will never think to search.

l5.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|She gives it to a droid, and tells it where to run.

e1.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|Two droids. One sealed lifeboat. No weapons, no escort, and no plan beyond the surface below.

e2.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|One of them is terrified. The other has simply decided.

e3.signature: en_GB-alan-medium|1.04|droid|Into that? We shall be smashed to atoms.

e5.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|To the gunners above it reads as debris. No life signs. Not worth a shot.

x1.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|And so the most dangerous secret of the war falls toward a desert, inside an unarmed droid that was given one instruction and no doubts at all.

x2.signature: en_US-ryan-high|1.16|cinematic|Everything that comes after begins here.
